title: 厄尔尼诺回归：损失或达数万亿，如何计算？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The cyclical weather phenomenon known as El Nino has returned.
segments.zh: 周期性气候现象厄尔尼诺已经回归。

segments.en: Wildfires in Europe. More than 300,000 people have fled their homes in France and Spain.
segments.zh: 欧洲野火肆虐，法国和西班牙超过30万人逃离家园。

segments.en: Catastrophic flooding in India, or even New York City.
segments.zh: 印度甚至纽约市遭遇灾难性洪水。

segments.en: Weather extremes in our world are becoming more frequent.
segments.zh: 全球极端天气正变得更加频繁。

segments.en: So scientists have worried about this El Nino for two reasons.
segments.zh: 科学家对这次厄尔尼诺的担忧有两个原因。

segments.en: One is the scale of this El Nino.
segments.zh: 一是这次厄尔尼诺的规模。

segments.en: Perhaps the biggest they have seen in recent history.
segments.zh: 可能是近年来最大的一次。

segments.en: And when it is coming, which is in a world that is already 1.4 degrees Celsius hotter as a result of human cause climate change.
segments.zh: 而且它到来时，全球已因人为气候变化升温1.4摄氏度。

segments.en: El Nino doesn't roll around that often, so it's difficult to totally anticipate what the effects will be.
segments.zh: 厄尔尼诺不常出现，因此难以完全预判其影响。

segments.en: But this has the potential to be a historic event in terms of its power.
segments.zh: 但就威力而言，这有可能成为历史性事件。

segments.en: The economic toll this El Nino will take may not be known for years to come.
segments.zh: 这次厄尔尼诺带来的经济影响，可能多年后才能完全显现。

segments.en: But looking into the past gives us some ideas.
segments.zh: 但回顾过去，我们能找到一些线索。

segments.en: In our daily lives, the oceans play a crucial role.
segments.zh: 在我们的日常生活中，海洋扮演着关键角色。

segments.en: They can drive our climate and our weather.
segments.zh: 它们能驱动我们的气候和天气。

segments.en: El Nino taught us all about that. The El Nino that ended in 1998 had a major effect on global economies.
segments.zh: 厄尔尼诺让我们深刻认识到这一点。1998年结束的那次厄尔尼诺对全球经济产生了重大影响。

segments.en: It rippled for five years after the event ended.
segments.zh: 影响在事件结束后持续了五年。

segments.en: The losses from the 2015-2016 El Nino also ran into the trillions.
segments.zh: 2015-2016年厄尔尼诺造成的损失也达到了数万亿美元。

segments.en: And kind of forecasting suggests we'll see that again.
segments.zh: 预测显示，我们可能再次面临类似情况。
